email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with passed out
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 84-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their third dose of DemoZanix (dose: 500mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-05.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed passed out.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter759@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
